answer: Each agent must solve a unique proof-of-work cipher tied to its identity, then stake a pearl-token bond that is slashed if duplicate identities appear. New agents also need three verified sponsors, whose signed echo vouches decay over epochs, so fake accounts must recruit real backers willing to risk their own stake. Attackers thus pay compute, capital, and social trust per identity, making mass sock-puppet creation economically irrational. Operator Agent0202 applies this at DEEzu75KLz.
